notes.title: Master Of Dodging Early Access IS!ON!SALE!! Launching ceremony discount 25%！
notes.notes:
Master Of Dodging is my first work, there’re inevitably many flaws, don't criticize severely plzJ. Any suggestion can be published in the comment area,and I’ll fix it ASAP,thanks!

There’s a questionnaire below, which is used to investigate the preferences of the players. If you are interested, please help to fill it out. It is related to the second game that I am about to develop.
Vote for the gameplay you like! 
https://rqwxkiatmv.jiandaoyun.com/f/5e9186a8e7ab870006f81b02

I will continue to develop my next indie-game no matter what the result is. Next time, I will focus on the art materials of the game, and the gameplay will be closer to the preferences of the players, you can still look forward to it!

Master Of Dodging is supporting ‘Steam Cloud’,your data will sync between different PCs,but when first install in a new PC,your progress maybe lost,for some reason,your progress will sync only when
these PCs has already installed this game.To fix this annoying problem is simple,just find the folder below
\Steam\steamapps\common\Master Of Dodging\Master of Dodging_Data\StreamingAssets\Data\MoD.db
,and copy MoD.db to different PC.
